checks.evidence: Official M0475.x4 full-byte SHA256 matches the frozen digest. The 12 M0475002 DCS/ERR-S literals, angle and energy ordering, and 6 separate M0475003 totals match the code and contract. DCS and total energy grids are disjoint. Parser verifies both digest and literal tables.

ERR-S is a declared sensitivity window, not confidence or likelihood. Nominal recorded angles are exact coordinates; cosine enclosures are arithmetic uncertainty, not experimental angle uncertainty. Evenness, finite nonnegative Bernstein cone, uniform azimuth and endpoint-zero extrapolation are declared assumptions. Primary Arends normalization remains unresolved; Rice summary is not promoted to that original convention.

Pairing j and n-j with a single middle basis is correct. Endpoint-zero removes j=0. The full integral is 4/(n+1) for pairs and 2/(n+1) for the middle. Inherited harmonic._power expands the same x=(mu+1)/2 Bernstein polynomial in mu, and new exact primitives integrate that polynomial. The independent manufactured-cap control expands directly in x.

harmonic.sincos_turn computes phase 4*pi*t, so theta/720 supplies cos(theta*pi/180). Positive Bernstein interval products and outward rational 2^-60 rounding conservatively enclose basis rows despite dependency loss. The inherited cosine output lies in [-1,1]. Actual interior-row lower bounds are guarded positive before enumeration.

For a>=0, l.a<=psi.a<=u.a. Therefore inner conditions u.a<=U and l.a>=L imply true feasibility; true feasibility implies outer l.a<=U and u.a>=L. Nonnegative variable constraints are included. Positive lower rows and finite U bound coordinates; at least one positive L excludes zero, giving d.a>0.

All dimension-sized active constraint subsets are enumerated without tolerance, singular exact systems skipped, exact feasible solutions retained and deduplicated. Every vertex of a bounded nonempty polytope has a full-rank active subset even for lower-dimensional polytopes. Positive-denominator linear-fractional values are denominator-weighted convex combinations of vertex values. Outward geometry coefficients therefore give valid outer-family bounds on every true feasible member.

The unchanged same-event Boolean coincidence set is used. Integrating nonnegative basis functions over inner/outer sets preserves coefficient order. Full sphere gives c=d and acceptance one; new manufactured rational-map controls independently check cap integrals. No independent-daughter product or absolute event-rate interpretation is introduced.

The saved-data reader does not invoke enumeration, ratio or integration functions; it independently rechecks stored vertex inequalities, positive denominators, inner-to-outer feasibility, coefficient ordering, witness membership and objective extrema over stored vertices. It does not independently prove vertex-list completeness: that obligation is supplied by reviewed exhaustive enumeration plus small known-polytope controls, not a falsely claimed second optimizer.

The four dimensions are 3,2,5,4 with 8+d constraints. Inner and outer enumeration totals 2*(C(11,3)+C(10,2)+C(13,5)+C(12,4))=3984 candidate matrix inversions, shared across three RHS vectors, with at most11952 candidate RHS solutions before singular skips.
